request: Build an active inpatient rehabilitation census showing MRN, FIN, patient full name, current nurse unit, room/bed, attending physician, and verified physical therapy treatment minutes with billed therapy charges.

interpretation_summary.top_form_family: Rehabilitation Therapy Productivity, Treatment Minutes & Billed CPT Units (PT / OT / SLP)
guardrails_triggered: TENANCY_FENCE: Target environment is a multi-tenant shared Millennium domain; custom CCL (.prg) upload is restricted. Primary deployable artifact must be a DA2 Domain Query + BIRT 4.4.2 .rptdesign.

CE_VERSION_DEDUP: CLINICAL_EVENT is row-versioned. Mandatory filter: CE Valid Until Dt/Tm >= 12/31/2100 00:00:00 AND CE Result Status in (Auth (Verified), Modified, Altered) (Code Set 8) to prevent superseded/In-Error rows from double-counting.

CE_EVENT_FILTER_LIST_AND_DTA_RESOLUTION: 'CE Event' (CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD, Code Set 72) contains 10,000+ PowerChart values. In DA2 Qualifications, use 'Modify Filter List...' -> 'Filter values:' substring search, or resolve via Event Set Hierarchy (Code Set 93 -> V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE) and Discrete Task Assay ('DTA Mnemonic', Code Set 14003).

NO_JOIN_REQUIRED_SCALAR_FUNCTIONS: When only primary encounter/person/charge values are needed in CWC Encounter, prefer DA2 inline scalar Functions ('Person MRN', 'Hm Addr *', 'Hm Phn Number', 'Enc Financial Num', 'Enc Attending Phys', 'Enc Attending Phys NPI', 'Enc Admitting Phys', 'Enc Case Manager', 'F Chg CPT', 'F Chg HCPCS', 'F Chg Rev Code') over 1-to-many child sub-entities to avoid row multiplication.

ACTIVE_CENSUS_NULL_DISCH: Never filter active census on Enc Disch Dt Tm >= <date>; active patients have Enc Disch Dt Tm IS NULL. Enforce Enc Admit Dt Tm <= cutoff AND Enc Disch Dt Tm IS NULL AND Enc Active Ind = 1, and uncheck DA2's auto-checked 'is not null' box on optional date prompts.

CROSS_DOMAIN_BIRT_JOIN: Request combines clinical (CWC Encounter) and financial/charge (CWF / Charges) entities. Emit two separate DA2 ODA datasets joined inside BIRT 4.4.2 via a <joint-data-set> on Enc Id (ENCNTR_ID) to prevent Cartesian fan-out.
DA2_ROW_CAP_GUARD: Enable 'Fetch All Rows From Data Source' on every dataset in BIRT to prevent DA2's silent 25,000-row truncation.

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_build_active_inpati:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_build_active_inpati:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Build an active inpatient rehabilitation census showing MRN, FIN, patient full name, current nurse unit, room/bed, attending physician, and verified physical therapy treatment minutes with billed therapy charges.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))
DECLARE c_attenddoc_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 333, "ATTENDDOC"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    pa_alias = trim(pa.alias, 3),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),
    epr_prsnl_person_id = cnvtstring(epr.prsnl_person_id, 17, 0),
    ce_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.event_id, 17, 0),
    c_charge_item_id = cnvtstring(c.charge_item_id, 17, 0),
    p_birth_dt_tm = format(p.birth_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_reg_dt_tm = format(e.reg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    epr_encntr_prsnl_r_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(epr.encntr_prsnl_r_cd), 3),
    ce_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_cd), 3),
    c_charge_description = trim(c.charge_description, 3),
    p_sex_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.sex_cd), 3),
    e_inpatient_admit_dt_tm = format(e.inpatient_admit_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    pr_name_full_formatted = trim(pr.name_full_formatted, 3),
    ce_result_val = trim(ce.result_val, 3),
    c_service_dt_tm = format(c.service_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    p_race_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.race_cd), 3),
    e_disch_dt_tm = format(e.disch_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    pr_position_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(pr.position_cd), 3),
    ce_result_units_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_units_cd), 3),
    c_item_quantity = c.item_quantity,
    e_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_type_cd), 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    PERSON_ALIAS pa,
    ENCNTR_PRSNL_RELTN epr,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    CHARGE c,
    PRSNL pr
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
      AND e.disch_dt_tm = NULL
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN pa
    WHERE pa.person_id = p.person_id
      AND pa.person_alias_type_cd = c_mrn_cd
      AND pa.active_ind = 1
      AND pa.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND pa.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN epr
    WHERE epr.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND epr.encntr_prsnl_r_cd = c_attenddoc_cd
      AND epr.active_ind = 1
      AND epr.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND epr.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN c
    WHERE c.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND c.active_ind = 1
JOIN pr
    WHERE pr.person_id = epr.prsnl_person_id
      AND pr.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_continuum_active_rehab_census_and_therapy_Primary_CWC [be6e4fb0-0789-56dc-905f-27acfcb77f79] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM >= TO_DATE('2100-12-31 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (25, 34, 35)
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_STATUS_CD IN (854)
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM IS NULL

  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  CWC_CHARGE.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS Chg_Bill_Item_Desc,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_QUANTITY AS Chg_Item_Quantity,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_EXTENDED_PRICE AS Chg_Item_Extended_Price,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CHARGE.SERVICE_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Chg_Service_Dt_Tm
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CHARGE CWC_CHARGE
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CHARGE.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CHARGE.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_STATUS_CD IN (854)
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM IS NULL

DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_determine_which_mil:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_determine_which_mil:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Determine which Millennium tables and columns hold charted PowerForm IRF-PAI / FIM / CARE functional assessment scores and generate a DA2 report and CCL query for verified answers.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    ce_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.event_id, 17, 0),
    dfr_description = trim(dfr.description, 3),
    ce_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_cd), 3),
    dfa_dcp_forms_activity_id = cnvtstring(dfa.dcp_forms_activity_id, 17, 0),
    ce_result_val = trim(ce.result_val, 3),
    dfa_form_dt_tm = format(dfa.form_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_result_units_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_units_cd), 3),
    dfa_form_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(dfa.form_status_cd), 3),
    ce_result_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_status_cd), 3),
    dfac_parent_entity_id = cnvtstring(dfac.parent_entity_id, 17, 0),
    ce_event_end_dt_tm = format(ce.event_end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ccr_nomenclature_id = cnvtstring(ccr.nomenclature_id, 17, 0),
    ce_valid_until_dt_tm = format(ce.valid_until_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_performed_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(ce.performed_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    ce_event_class_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_class_cd), 3),
    ce_clinical_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.clinical_event_id, 17, 0)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    DCP_FORMS_REF dfr,
    DCP_FORMS_ACTIVITY dfa,
    DCP_FORMS_ACTIVITY_COMP dfac,
    CE_CODED_RESULT ccr
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN dfr
    WHERE dfr.dcp_forms_ref_id = dfa.dcp_forms_ref_id
      AND dfr.active_ind = 1
JOIN dfa
    WHERE dfa.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND dfa.active_ind = 1
JOIN dfac
    WHERE dfac.dcp_forms_activity_id = dfa.dcp_forms_activity_id
      AND dfac.parent_entity_name = "CLINICAL_EVENT"
JOIN ccr
    WHERE ccr.event_id = ce.event_id
      AND ccr.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID

  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (25, 34, 35)

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_create_barcode_medi:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_create_barcode_medi:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Create a barcode medication administration (BCMA) audit report showing patient name, FIN, nurse unit, medication order mnemonic, scheduled date/time, performed date/time, patient/medication barcode scan indicators, and administered dosage.
; Tenancy Profile: communityworks
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),
    o_order_id = cnvtstring(o.order_id, 17, 0),
    mae_med_admin_event_id = cnvtstring(mae.med_admin_event_id, 17, 0),
    sa_sch_appt_id = cnvtstring(sa.sch_appt_id, 17, 0),
    p_birth_dt_tm = format(p.birth_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_catalog_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.catalog_cd), 3),
    mae_event_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(mae.event_type_cd), 3),
    sa_beg_dt_tm = format(sa.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    p_sex_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.sex_cd), 3),
    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    o_order_mnemonic = trim(o.order_mnemonic, 3),
    mae_beg_dt_tm = format(mae.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_end_dt_tm = format(sa.end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    p_race_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.race_cd), 3),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    o_order_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.order_status_cd), 3),
    mae_scheduled_dt_tm = format(mae.scheduled_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_duration = sa.duration,
    elh_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_orig_order_dt_tm = format(o.orig_order_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    mae_positive_patient_ident_ind = mae.positive_patient_ident_ind,
    sa_sch_state_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sa.sch_state_cd), 3),
    o_clinical_display_line = trim(o.clinical_display_line, 3),
    mae_positive_med_ident_ind = mae.positive_med_ident_ind
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    ORDERS o,
    MED_ADMIN_EVENT mae,
    SCH_APPT sa,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN o
    WHERE o.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND o.active_ind = 1
JOIN mae
    WHERE mae.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sa
    WHERE sa.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND sa.role_meaning = "PATIENT"
      AND sa.active_ind = 1
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

guardrails_triggered: CE_VERSION_DEDUP: CLINICAL_EVENT is row-versioned. Mandatory filter: CE Valid Until Dt/Tm >= 12/31/2100 00:00:00 AND CE Result Status in (Auth (Verified), Modified, Altered) (Code Set 8) to prevent superseded/In-Error rows from double-counting.

CE_EVENT_FILTER_LIST_AND_DTA_RESOLUTION: 'CE Event' (CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD, Code Set 72) contains 10,000+ PowerChart values. In DA2 Qualifications, use 'Modify Filter List...' -> 'Filter values:' substring search, or resolve via Event Set Hierarchy (Code Set 93 -> V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE) and Discrete Task Assay ('DTA Mnemonic', Code Set 14003).

NO_JOIN_REQUIRED_SCALAR_FUNCTIONS: When only primary encounter/person/charge values are needed in CWC Encounter, prefer DA2 inline scalar Functions ('Person MRN', 'Hm Addr *', 'Hm Phn Number', 'Enc Financial Num', 'Enc Attending Phys', 'Enc Attending Phys NPI', 'Enc Admitting Phys', 'Enc Case Manager', 'F Chg CPT', 'F Chg HCPCS', 'F Chg Rev Code') over 1-to-many child sub-entities to avoid row multiplication.

CROSS_DOMAIN_BIRT_JOIN: Request combines clinical (CWC Encounter) and financial/charge (CWF / Charges) entities. Emit two separate DA2 ODA datasets joined inside BIRT 4.4.2 via a <joint-data-set> on Enc Id (ENCNTR_ID) to prevent Cartesian fan-out.
DA2_ROW_CAP_GUARD: Enable 'Fetch All Rows From Data Source' on every dataset in BIRT to prevent DA2's silent 25,000-row truncation.

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_locate_tables_colum:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_locate_tables_colum:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Locate the tables and columns that store Dynamic Documentation PowerNotes and discharge summary narrative text blobs and compile a Standalone RHO CCL query that extracts finalized notes.
; Tenancy Profile: standalone_rho
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    ce_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.event_id, 17, 0),
    mae_med_admin_event_id = cnvtstring(mae.med_admin_event_id, 17, 0),
    c_charge_item_id = cnvtstring(c.charge_item_id, 17, 0),
    e_reg_dt_tm = format(e.reg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_cd), 3),
    mae_event_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(mae.event_type_cd), 3),
    c_charge_description = trim(c.charge_description, 3),
    e_inpatient_admit_dt_tm = format(e.inpatient_admit_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_event_title_text = trim(ce.event_title_text, 3),
    mae_beg_dt_tm = format(mae.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_service_dt_tm = format(c.service_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_disch_dt_tm = format(e.disch_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_performed_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(ce.performed_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    mae_scheduled_dt_tm = format(mae.scheduled_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_item_quantity = c.item_quantity,
    e_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_type_cd), 3),
    ce_performed_dt_tm = format(ce.performed_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    mae_positive_patient_ident_ind = mae.positive_patient_ident_ind,
    c_item_extended_price = c.item_extended_price,
    e_encntr_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_status_cd), 3),
    ce_verified_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(ce.verified_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    mae_positive_med_ident_ind = mae.positive_med_ident_ind,
    cm_field6 = trim(cm.field6, 3),
    e_disch_disposition_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.disch_disposition_cd), 3),
    ce_verified_dt_tm = format(ce.verified_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    cmr_admin_dosage = cmr.admin_dosage
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    MED_ADMIN_EVENT mae,
    CHARGE c,
    CHARGE_MOD cm,
    CE_MED_RESULT cmr
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN mae
    WHERE mae.event_id = ce.event_id
JOIN c
    WHERE c.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND c.active_ind = 1
JOIN cm
    WHERE cm.charge_item_id = c.charge_item_id
      AND cm.active_ind = 1
JOIN cmr
    WHERE cmr.event_id = ce.event_id
      AND cmr.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

guardrails_triggered: TENANCY_FENCE: Target environment is a multi-tenant shared Millennium domain; custom CCL (.prg) upload is restricted. Primary deployable artifact must be a DA2 Domain Query + BIRT 4.4.2 .rptdesign.

CE_VERSION_DEDUP: CLINICAL_EVENT is row-versioned. Mandatory filter: CE Valid Until Dt/Tm >= 12/31/2100 00:00:00 AND CE Result Status in (Auth (Verified), Modified, Altered) (Code Set 8) to prevent superseded/In-Error rows from double-counting.

CE_EVENT_FILTER_LIST_AND_DTA_RESOLUTION: 'CE Event' (CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD, Code Set 72) contains 10,000+ PowerChart values. In DA2 Qualifications, use 'Modify Filter List...' -> 'Filter values:' substring search, or resolve via Event Set Hierarchy (Code Set 93 -> V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE) and Discrete Task Assay ('DTA Mnemonic', Code Set 14003).

NO_JOIN_REQUIRED_SCALAR_FUNCTIONS: When only primary encounter/person/charge values are needed in CWC Encounter, prefer DA2 inline scalar Functions ('Person MRN', 'Hm Addr *', 'Hm Phn Number', 'Enc Financial Num', 'Enc Attending Phys', 'Enc Attending Phys NPI', 'Enc Admitting Phys', 'Enc Case Manager', 'F Chg CPT', 'F Chg HCPCS', 'F Chg Rev Code') over 1-to-many child sub-entities to avoid row multiplication.

CROSS_DOMAIN_BIRT_JOIN: Request combines clinical (CWC Encounter) and financial/charge (CWF / Charges) entities. Emit two separate DA2 ODA datasets joined inside BIRT 4.4.2 via a <joint-data-set> on Enc Id (ENCNTR_ID) to prevent Cartesian fan-out.
DA2_ROW_CAP_GUARD: Enable 'Fetch All Rows From Data Source' on every dataset in BIRT to prevent DA2's silent 25,000-row truncation.

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_identify_millennium:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_identify_millennium:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Identify the Millennium columns for InteractiveView vital signs and 2G Intake and Output fluid balance volumes (mL) and generate a DA2 query and CCL program.
; Tenancy Profile: communityworks
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    ce_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.event_id, 17, 0),
    cio_io_volume = cio.io_volume,
    ce_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_cd), 3),
    cio_io_type_flag = cio.io_type_flag,
    ce_result_val = trim(ce.result_val, 3),
    cio_reference_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(cio.reference_event_cd), 3),
    ce_result_units_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_units_cd), 3),
    cio_io_end_dt_tm = format(cio.io_end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_result_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_status_cd), 3),
    ce_event_end_dt_tm = format(ce.event_end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_valid_until_dt_tm = format(ce.valid_until_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    ce_performed_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(ce.performed_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    ce_event_class_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_class_cd), 3),
    ce_clinical_event_id = cnvtstring(ce.clinical_event_id, 17, 0),
    pe_balance = pe.balance
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    CE_INTAKE_OUTPUT_RESULT cio,
    PFT_ENCNTR pe
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN cio
    WHERE cio.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND cio.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
JOIN pe
    WHERE pe.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND pe.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM >= TO_DATE('2100-12-31 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (25, 34, 35)

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_audit_inpatient_dis:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_audit_inpatient_dis:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Audit inpatient discharges with opioid and benzodiazepine medication orders, pulling Order Entry Format details (dose, route, frequency, indication), discharge disposition, facility, and patient age.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    o_person_id = cnvtstring(o.person_id, 17, 0),
    o_order_id = cnvtstring(o.order_id, 17, 0),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),
    c_charge_item_id = cnvtstring(c.charge_item_id, 17, 0),
    p_birth_dt_tm = format(p.birth_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_reg_dt_tm = format(e.reg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_catalog_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.catalog_cd), 3),
    c_charge_description = trim(c.charge_description, 3),
    p_sex_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.sex_cd), 3),
    e_inpatient_admit_dt_tm = format(e.inpatient_admit_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    o_order_mnemonic = trim(o.order_mnemonic, 3),
    c_service_dt_tm = format(c.service_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    p_race_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.race_cd), 3),
    e_disch_dt_tm = format(e.disch_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    o_order_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.order_status_cd), 3),
    c_item_quantity = c.item_quantity,
    e_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_type_cd), 3),
    elh_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_orig_order_dt_tm = format(o.orig_order_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_item_extended_price = c.item_extended_price,
    e_encntr_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_status_cd), 3),
    o_clinical_display_line = trim(o.clinical_display_line, 3),
    cm_field6 = trim(cm.field6, 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    ORDERS o,
    CHARGE c,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh,
    CHARGE_MOD cm
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN o
    WHERE o.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND o.active_ind = 1
JOIN c
    WHERE c.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND c.active_ind = 1
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN cm
    WHERE cm.charge_item_id = c.charge_item_id
      AND cm.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_order_entry_format_opioid_benzo_audit_Primary_CWC [e0084cd5-f15f-5967-b288-f1eae9cd0af7] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_generate_outpatient:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_generate_outpatient:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Generate an outpatient therapy scheduling report with appointment begin/end times, duration, appointment state, scheduling action history, and cancellation or no-show reasons.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    sa_sch_appt_id = cnvtstring(sa.sch_appt_id, 17, 0),
    sa_beg_dt_tm = format(sa.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_end_dt_tm = format(sa.end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_duration = sa.duration,
    sa_sch_state_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sa.sch_state_cd), 3),
    se_appt_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(se.appt_type_cd), 3),
    sea_sch_action_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sea.sch_action_cd), 3),
    sea_sch_reason_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sea.sch_reason_cd), 3),
    sea_action_dt_tm = format(sea.action_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D")
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    SCH_APPT sa,
    SCH_EVENT se,
    SCH_EVENT_ACTION sea
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN sa
    WHERE sa.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND sa.role_meaning = "PATIENT"
      AND sa.active_ind = 1
JOIN se
    WHERE se.sch_event_id = sa.sch_event_id
      AND se.active_ind = 1
JOIN sea
    WHERE sea.sch_event_id = se.sch_event_id
      AND sea.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

interpretation_summary.top_form_family: Patient Accounting / Revenue Cycle Billing, Payments, Adjustments & GL Output (CWF)
guardrails_triggered: DA2_VIEW_ALIAS_RESOLUTION: Keep DA2 view/alias names (XCW_* / CWC_*) distinct from raw V500 table names: XCW_ENCOUNTER (alias=ENCOUNTER, da2_join_key=ENCOUNTER_ID -> raw V500 ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID)
TENANCY_FENCE: Target environment is a multi-tenant shared Millennium domain; custom CCL (.prg) upload is restricted. Primary deployable artifact must be a DA2 Domain Query + BIRT 4.4.2 .rptdesign.

NO_JOIN_REQUIRED_SCALAR_FUNCTIONS: When only primary encounter/person/charge values are needed in CWC Encounter, prefer DA2 inline scalar Functions ('Person MRN', 'Hm Addr *', 'Hm Phn Number', 'Enc Financial Num', 'Enc Attending Phys', 'Enc Attending Phys NPI', 'Enc Admitting Phys', 'Enc Case Manager', 'F Chg CPT', 'F Chg HCPCS', 'F Chg Rev Code') over 1-to-many child sub-entities to avoid row multiplication.

CROSS_DOMAIN_BIRT_JOIN: Request combines clinical (CWC Encounter) and financial/charge (CWF / Charges) entities. Emit two separate DA2 ODA datasets joined inside BIRT 4.4.2 via a <joint-data-set> on Enc Id (ENCNTR_ID) to prevent Cartesian fan-out.
DA2_ROW_CAP_GUARD: Enable 'Fetch All Rows From Data Source' on every dataset in BIRT to prevent DA2's silent 25,000-row truncation.

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_build_cross_domain:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_build_cross_domain:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Build a cross-domain clinical and financial reconciliation report joining encounter admit/discharge dates and primary health plan with Benefit Order total charges, total payments, and total adjustments.
; Tenancy Profile: communityworks
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),
    o_order_id = cnvtstring(o.order_id, 17, 0),
    mae_med_admin_event_id = cnvtstring(mae.med_admin_event_id, 17, 0),
    c_charge_item_id = cnvtstring(c.charge_item_id, 17, 0),
    e_reg_dt_tm = format(e.reg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_catalog_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.catalog_cd), 3),
    mae_event_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(mae.event_type_cd), 3),
    c_charge_description = trim(c.charge_description, 3),
    e_inpatient_admit_dt_tm = format(e.inpatient_admit_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    o_order_mnemonic = trim(o.order_mnemonic, 3),
    mae_beg_dt_tm = format(mae.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_service_dt_tm = format(c.service_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_disch_dt_tm = format(e.disch_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    o_order_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.order_status_cd), 3),
    mae_scheduled_dt_tm = format(mae.scheduled_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_item_quantity = c.item_quantity,
    e_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_type_cd), 3),
    elh_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    o_orig_order_dt_tm = format(o.orig_order_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    mae_positive_patient_ident_ind = mae.positive_patient_ident_ind,
    c_item_extended_price = c.item_extended_price,
    e_encntr_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_status_cd), 3),
    o_clinical_display_line = trim(o.clinical_display_line, 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    ORDERS o,
    MED_ADMIN_EVENT mae,
    CHARGE c,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN o
    WHERE o.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND o.active_ind = 1
JOIN mae
    WHERE mae.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN c
    WHERE c.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND c.active_ind = 1
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_revcycle_cwf_charges_payments_adjustments_Primary_CWC [4d83e814-0691-5007-95f6-2c8c7dee8e81] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM >= TO_DATE('2100-12-31 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_revcycle_cwf_charges_payments_adjustments_Secondary_Detail [ed8cc273-8f13-5de3-af6a-85382685fadd] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  CWC_CHARGE.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS Chg_Bill_Item_Desc,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_QUANTITY AS Chg_Item_Quantity,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_EXTENDED_PRICE AS Chg_Item_Extended_Price,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CHARGE.SERVICE_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Chg_Service_Dt_Tm
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CHARGE CWC_CHARGE
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CHARGE.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CHARGE.ACTIVE_IND = 1

DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_extract_overdue_not:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_extract_overdue_not:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Extract overdue and not-done clinical care tasks from the nursing inbox including task status, task status reason, PRN vs scheduled task class, and scheduled overdue timestamp.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),

    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    ce_result_val = trim(ce.result_val, 3),
    ta_task_status_reason_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ta.task_status_reason_cd), 3),
    sa_end_dt_tm = format(sa.end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    ce_result_units_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_units_cd), 3),
    ta_task_class_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ta.task_class_cd), 3),
    sa_duration = sa.duration,
    elh_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    ce_result_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.result_status_cd), 3),
    ta_scheduled_dt_tm = format(ta.scheduled_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_sch_state_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sa.sch_state_cd), 3),
    ce_event_end_dt_tm = format(ce.event_end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    se_appt_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(se.appt_type_cd), 3),
    ce_valid_until_dt_tm = format(ce.valid_until_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sea_sch_action_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sea.sch_action_cd), 3),
    ce_performed_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(ce.performed_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    sea_sch_reason_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sea.sch_reason_cd), 3),
    ce_event_class_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_class_cd), 3),
    sea_action_dt_tm = format(sea.action_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D")
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    TASK_ACTIVITY ta,
    SCH_APPT sa,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh,
    SCH_EVENT se,
    SCH_EVENT_ACTION sea
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN ta
    WHERE ta.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ta.active_ind = 1
JOIN sa
    WHERE sa.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND sa.role_meaning = "PATIENT"
      AND sa.active_ind = 1
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN se
    WHERE se.sch_event_id = sa.sch_event_id
      AND se.active_ind = 1
JOIN sea
    WHERE sea.sch_event_id = se.sch_event_id
      AND sea.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,

DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_millennium_data_mod:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_millennium_data_mod:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Find the Millennium Data Model tables and columns that track CPDI interactive eSignature consent forms and document imaging completion status.
; Tenancy Profile: standalone_rho
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

    elh_encntr_loc_hist_id = cnvtstring(elh.encntr_loc_hist_id, 17, 0),
    mae_med_admin_event_id = cnvtstring(mae.med_admin_event_id, 17, 0),
    sea_sch_action_id = cnvtstring(sea.sch_action_id, 17, 0),
    elh_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.encntr_type_cd), 3),
    elh_encntr_type_class_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.encntr_type_class_cd), 3),
    elh_med_service_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.med_service_cd), 3),
    elh_placement_auth_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(elh.placement_auth_prsnl_id, 17, 0)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh,
    MED_ADMIN_EVENT mae,
    SCH_EVENT_ACTION sea
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN mae
    WHERE mae.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sea
    WHERE sea.sch_event_id = se.sch_event_id
      AND sea.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,

WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_traverse_level_v500:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_traverse_level_v500:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Traverse the 10-level V500_EVENT_SET_CANON and V500_EVENT_SET_CODE hierarchy rooted at ALL OCF EVENT SETS (MD_D_EVENT_SET_HIERARCHY and MD_D_EVENT_SET_SEARCH) to explode bottom-level event sets via V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE into leaf CLINICAL_EVENT EVENT_CD values.
; Tenancy Profile: standalone_rho
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    e_loc_facility_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_facility_cd), 3),
    esc_event_set_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(esc.event_set_cd), 3),
    e_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    esc_event_set_name = trim(esc.event_set_name, 3),
    e_loc_room_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_room_cd), 3),
    esc_event_set_cd_disp = trim(esc.event_set_cd_disp, 3),
    e_loc_bed_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.loc_bed_cd), 3),
    esc_event_set_cd_definition = trim(esc.event_set_cd_definition, 3),
    elh_loc_nurse_unit_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(elh.loc_nurse_unit_cd), 3),
    escan_parent_event_set_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(escan.parent_event_set_cd), 3),
    escan_event_set_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(escan.event_set_cd), 3),
    esexp_event_set_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(esexp.event_set_cd), 3),
    esexp_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(esexp.event_cd), 3),
    ce_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ce.event_cd), 3),
    ta_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(ta.event_cd), 3),
    dfr_event_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(dfr.event_cd), 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    V500_EVENT_SET_CODE esc,
    ENCNTR_LOC_HIST elh,
    V500_EVENT_SET_CANON escan,
    V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE esexp,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    TASK_ACTIVITY ta,
    DCP_FORMS_REF dfr
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN esc
    WHERE esc.event_set_cd = escan.parent_event_set_cd
JOIN elh
    WHERE elh.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND elh.active_ind = 1
      AND elh.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND elh.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN escan
    WHERE escan.event_set_cd = esexp.event_set_cd
JOIN esexp
    WHERE esexp.event_cd = ce.event_cd
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN ta
    WHERE ta.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ta.active_ind = 1
JOIN dfr
    WHERE dfr.dcp_forms_ref_id = dfa.dcp_forms_ref_id
      AND dfr.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_generate_inpatient:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_generate_inpatient:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Generate an inpatient HCAHPS and regulatory discharge extract with Person Language (Code Set 36, HL7 PID-15), UB-04 FL-15 Point of Origin / Enc Admit Source (Code Set 2), UB-04 FL-17 Enc Discharge Disp (Code Set 19), F Enc Recur Seq, and HP Plan Name Key.
; Tenancy Profile: continuum
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    c_charge_item_id = cnvtstring(c.charge_item_id, 17, 0),
    p_language_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.language_cd), 3),
    e_admit_src_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.admit_src_cd), 3),
    p_birth_dt_tm = format(p.birth_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_reg_dt_tm = format(e.reg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    e_disch_disposition_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.disch_disposition_cd), 3),
    c_charge_description = trim(c.charge_description, 3),
    p_sex_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.sex_cd), 3),
    e_inpatient_admit_dt_tm = format(e.inpatient_admit_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_service_dt_tm = format(c.service_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    pe_recur_seq = pe.recur_seq,
    p_race_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(p.race_cd), 3),
    e_disch_dt_tm = format(e.disch_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    c_item_quantity = c.item_quantity,
    e_encntr_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_type_cd), 3),
    c_item_extended_price = c.item_extended_price,
    e_encntr_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(e.encntr_status_cd), 3),
    cm_field6 = trim(cm.field6, 3),
    pe_pft_encntr_id = cnvtstring(pe.pft_encntr_id, 17, 0),
    e_active_ind = e.active_ind,
    pe_balance = pe.balance,
    hp_plan_name = trim(hp.plan_name, 3),
    c_abn_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(c.abn_status_cd), 3),
    c_active_status_prsnl_id = cnvtstring(c.active_status_prsnl_id, 17, 0),
    c_activity_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(c.activity_type_cd), 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CHARGE c,
    PFT_ENCNTR pe,
    CHARGE_MOD cm,
    HEALTH_PLAN hp
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN c
    WHERE c.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND c.active_ind = 1
JOIN pe
    WHERE pe.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND pe.active_ind = 1
JOIN cm
    WHERE cm.charge_item_id = c.charge_item_id
      AND cm.active_ind = 1
JOIN hp
    WHERE hp.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_hcahps_language_pid15_and_ub04_admit_discharge_extract_Query [b30e0197-8889-568c-bf03-c5dd54a975cf] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status,
  CWC_CHARGE.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS Chg_Bill_Item_Desc,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_QUANTITY AS Chg_Item_Quantity,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_EXTENDED_PRICE AS Chg_Item_Extended_Price,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CHARGE.SERVICE_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Chg_Service_Dt_Tm
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT,
     V500.CHARGE CWC_CHARGE
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM >= TO_DATE('2100-12-31 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (25, 34, 35)
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CHARGE.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CHARGE.ACTIVE_IND = 1

ccl_source:
DROP PROGRAM cust_da2_audit_controlled_su:dba GO
CREATE PROGRAM cust_da2_audit_controlled_su:dba

PROMPT
    "Output to File/Printer/MINE" = "MINE",
    "Begin Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE-7",
    "End Date (DD-MMM-YYYY)" = "CURDATE"
WITH OUTDEV, BEG_DT, END_DT

;=============================================================================
; Generated by Discern Intelligence V1 for: Audit controlled substance medication administrations using MLTM_NDC_MAIN_DRUG_CODE CSA_SCHEDULE (Mltm Legal Status), Order Mnemonic, Order AS Mnemonic, Med Adm Id, and CE Med Admin Dose.
; Tenancy Profile: communityworks
;=============================================================================

DECLARE c_fin_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 319, "FIN NBR"))
DECLARE c_mrn_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 4, "MRN"))
DECLARE c_auth_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "AUTH"))
DECLARE c_modified_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "MODIFIED"))
DECLARE c_altered_cd = f8 WITH protect, constant(uar_get_code_by("MEANING", 8, "ALTERED"))

SELECT INTO $OUTDEV
    encntr_id = cnvtstring(e.encntr_id, 17, 0),
    fin = trim(ea.alias, 3),
    person_id = cnvtstring(p.person_id, 17, 0),
    patient_name = trim(p.name_full_formatted, 3),
    o_order_id = cnvtstring(o.order_id, 17, 0),
    mae_med_admin_event_id = cnvtstring(mae.med_admin_event_id, 17, 0),
    sa_sch_appt_id = cnvtstring(sa.sch_appt_id, 17, 0),
    mltm_csa_schedule = trim(mltm.csa_schedule, 3),
    o_catalog_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.catalog_cd), 3),
    mae_event_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(mae.event_type_cd), 3),
    sa_beg_dt_tm = format(sa.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    o_hna_order_mnemonic = trim(o.hna_order_mnemonic, 3),
    o_order_mnemonic = trim(o.order_mnemonic, 3),
    mae_beg_dt_tm = format(mae.beg_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_end_dt_tm = format(sa.end_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    o_ordered_as_mnemonic = trim(o.ordered_as_mnemonic, 3),
    o_order_status_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(o.order_status_cd), 3),
    mae_scheduled_dt_tm = format(mae.scheduled_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    sa_duration = sa.duration,
    o_orig_order_dt_tm = format(o.orig_order_dt_tm, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS;;D"),
    mae_positive_patient_ident_ind = mae.positive_patient_ident_ind,
    cmr_admin_dosage = cmr.admin_dosage,
    sa_sch_state_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(sa.sch_state_cd), 3),
    o_clinical_display_line = trim(o.clinical_display_line, 3),
    mae_positive_med_ident_ind = mae.positive_med_ident_ind,
    se_appt_type_cd = trim(uar_get_code_display(se.appt_type_cd), 3)
FROM
    ENCOUNTER e,
    PERSON p,
    ENCNTR_ALIAS ea,
    CLINICAL_EVENT ce,
    ORDERS o,
    MED_ADMIN_EVENT mae,
    SCH_APPT sa,
    MLTM_NDC_MAIN_DRUG_CODE mltm,
    CE_MED_RESULT cmr,
    SCH_EVENT se
PLAN e
    WHERE e.active_ind = 1
      AND e.reg_dt_tm BETWEEN cnvtdatetime(concat($BEG_DT, " 00:00:00"))
                          AND cnvtdatetime(concat($END_DT, " 23:59:59"))
JOIN p
    WHERE p.person_id = e.person_id
      AND p.active_ind = 1
JOIN ea
    WHERE ea.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ea.encntr_alias_type_cd = c_fin_cd
      AND ea.active_ind = 1
      AND ea.beg_effective_dt_tm <= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
      AND ea.end_effective_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime(curdate, curtime3)
JOIN ce
    WHERE ce.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND ce.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
      AND ce.result_status_cd IN (c_auth_cd, c_modified_cd, c_altered_cd)
      AND ce.view_level = 1
JOIN o
    WHERE o.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND o.active_ind = 1
JOIN mae
    WHERE mae.event_id = ce.event_id
JOIN sa
    WHERE sa.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
      AND sa.role_meaning = "PATIENT"
      AND sa.active_ind = 1
JOIN mltm
    WHERE mltm.drug_identifier > ' '
JOIN cmr
    WHERE cmr.event_id = ce.event_id
      AND cmr.valid_until_dt_tm >= cnvtdatetime("31-DEC-2100 00:00:00")
JOIN se
    WHERE se.sch_event_id = sa.sch_event_id
      AND se.active_ind = 1
ORDER BY
    e.encntr_id,
    p.name_full_formatted
WITH NOCOUNTER, SEPARATOR = " ", FORMAT, TIME = 120

END
GO

/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: DA2_controlled_substance_mar_mltm_csa_schedule_audit_Query [4ba22cc9-b2db-5398-a36c-e5b7f53f534f] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID AS Enc_Id,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD) AS CE_Event,
  CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_VAL AS CE_Result_Value,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_END_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS CE_Event_End_Dt_Tm,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD) AS CE_Result_Status,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ORDERS.CATALOG_CD) AS Order_Catalog,
  CWC_ORDERS.ORDER_MNEMONIC AS Order_Mnemonic,
  CWC_ORDERS.CLINICAL_DISPLAY_LINE AS Order_Clinical_Display_Line,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS_CD) AS Order_Status,
  CWC_CHARGE.CHARGE_DESCRIPTION AS Chg_Bill_Item_Desc,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_QUANTITY AS Chg_Item_Quantity,
  CWC_CHARGE.ITEM_EXTENDED_PRICE AS Chg_Item_Extended_Price,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_CHARGE.SERVICE_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Chg_Service_Dt_Tm
FROM V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON,
     V500.CLINICAL_EVENT CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT,
     V500.ORDERS CWC_ORDERS,
     V500.CHARGE CWC_CHARGE
WHERE CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ACTIVE_IND = 1
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM >= TO_DATE('2100-12-31 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  AND CWC_CLINICAL_EVENT.RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (25, 34, 35)
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_ORDERS.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_ORDERS.ACTIVE_IND = 1
